verdict: Instagram ads produced 403 leads at roughly $26 each this period — well below legal-industry norms.
diagnosis: Spent $10,371 on Meta to drive 403 leads, but only 335 fired the pixel and phone calls dropped sharply late-period.

signals.headline: 403 leads at $25.73 each
signals.detail: Lead volume is strong for the debt-relief niche, and cost per lead sits well under typical legal Meta benchmarks.

signals.headline: Pixel captured only 335 of 403
signals.detail: A 17% gap between form leads and pixel-tracked leads suggests tracking or attribution is leaking data.

signals.headline: 187 call clicks from Google profile
signals.detail: Local presence drove roughly 2-3 calls per day, but recent daily counts hit zero — momentum is slowing.

signals.headline: 82 new reviews, 5-star average
signals.detail: Reputation is a real asset. Reviews now total 852 with perfect ratings, reinforcing trust for paid traffic.

signals.headline: 3,146 link clicks, 2,296 landing views
signals.detail: Roughly 27% of clicks never reach the landing page. Page speed or redirect issues are worth checking.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Median cost per lead on Meta for legal advertisers is around $180, with consumer categories like bankruptcy running $35-$90. Justice Consumer Law's $26 figure is exceptionally low for the vertical.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.body: Law firm acquisition costs have climbed roughly 30% since 2023 as AI-driven bidding intensifies competition. September typically brings post-summer demand spikes as consumers address delayed financial matters.

competitor.label: Competitor
competitor.subheader: Facebook still tops paid social for firms
competitor.body: About 28% of law firms rank Facebook Ads as their top paid social channel. Consumer-facing practices see the strongest results from in-platform lead forms rather than off-site landing pages.

recommendations.title: Fix the pixel gap between form leads and tracked conversions
recommendations.detail: Consider auditing the Meta pixel and conversions API setup. Closing the 17% gap between 403 form leads and 335 pixel events will sharpen future optimization.

recommendations.title: Test a second creative against Video Ad 04 V4
recommendations.detail: One ad is carrying the campaign. Worth testing a second video variant to guard against creative fatigue before cost per lead drifts upward.

recommendations.title: Push more traffic to the Google Business Profile
recommendations.detail: With 82 five-star reviews added and 187 call clicks this period, consider requesting reviews in intake follow-ups to sustain local ranking momentum.
